stories.title: Jamia UPSC Society's Mela 2.0 draws over 1,150 aspirants, with focus on disability-inclusive preparation
stories.body: A civil services awareness event run by the Jamia UPSC Society drew more than 1,150 students and aspirants from Jamia Millia Islamia and other universities, according to an IANS report published on Tuesday 13 October. The report describes the society as an alumni initiative of Jamia's Residential Coaching Academy, organised with the university's Office of the Grievance Redressal Officer for Persons with Disabilities and sponsored by a coaching institute. Vice-Chancellor Mazhar Asif urged students to pursue their goals with discipline and a sense of responsibility. Successful candidates and two retired officers spoke with students, and the report says the event stressed accessible exam opportunities for students with disabilities. It says the event was held "last week" and gives no date or venue.
stories.check: Single source (IANS, via SocialNews.XYZ). Event date and venue are not stated, and the item is not on Jamia's press release page (latest listed is 12 October). Confirm with Jamia.
